command_center.decision_question: Which AI/technology bets deserve more capital, which need evidence, which are blocked, and which should stop?
command_center.executive_summary: Total technology budget is not yet loaded, so the run/change split cannot be shown. AI-tagged spend is $53.9M against $3454.2M promised value, of which finance has partially validated $437.7M. Across funded bets the decision posture is 20 fund, 14 fix, 2 freeze. Realized value stays blocked until usage, KPI movement, and finance validation line up.
